notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard Divestiture If Wanted with independently pending regular and If Available acquirers. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies exact attribute-set transfer, callback tags, ownership state, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition, attributeOwnershipAcquisitionIfAvailable, attributeOwnershipDivestitureIfWanted, ownership-query, publication, and resignation services with standard ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-management declarations
